tasks.description: Identify RECENT appointments (within the last 12 months) to ONLY the following roles in the target organisation: CEO, CFO, COO, CTO. Do not include any other titles. Exclude subsidiary, regional, country, or functional roles. Each result must include full name, exact title, organisation, appointment date, and source URL.

Identify RECENT appointments (within the last 12 months) to Chief Officer roles in the target organisation EXCLUDING CEO, CFO, COO, and CTO. Valid titles include CMO, CIO, CISO, CHRO, Chief Data Officer, Chief Digital Officer, Chief Transformation Officer, or equivalent. Exclude regional, country, or subsidiary roles.

Identify RECENT appointments (within the last 12 months) to leadership roles responsible for a specific business unit, division, product line, or vertical within the target organisation. Titles must clearly indicate ownership of a unit (e.g., 'Head of Payments', 'President – Retail Banking'). Exclude geographic, C-suite, and subsidiary roles.

Identify RECENT appointments (within the last 12 months) to geographic leadership roles within the target organisation. Valid titles include Country Head, Regional Head, Area Head, or equivalent. Exclude global roles, functional roles, and subsidiary CEO/MD positions.

Identify RECENT appointments (within the last 12 months) to top leadership roles in subsidiaries or child organisations of the target organisation. Valid titles include CEO, Managing Director, or Country CEO of the subsidiary. The parent–subsidiary relationship must be explicitly confirmed. Exclude appointments already counted at the parent organisation level.
